# live

<!-- Generated by nightseam from nightseam:live/; do not edit. -->

A family of the `nightseam.duplex/1` profile, declared in `nightseam:live/model.json`, `nightseam:live/protocol.json`.
The tiers it declares bring the built-in family `duplex`, imported implicitly.

## Types

### Invoke

A record. One invocation of an exported binding.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `binding` | `string` | required | — | The binding to invoke. |
| `contract` | `string` | required | — | The declaration the caller believes the binding implements; a mismatch is refused before dispatch. |
| `request` | `json` | optional | — | The callable's request, validated against the declared type; absent when the callable takes nothing. |

### Invoked

A record. What an invocation answers.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `result` | `json` | optional | — | The callable's result, validated against the declared type; absent when the callable answers nothing. |

### Reference

A record. A live value on the wire: one exported binding within one scope. It is the language's projection of the callable kind — what a value of a callable type is when it crosses the seam — and no family declares it or names it.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `binding` | `string` | required | — | The binding, minted by the scope that exported it and opaque to everyone else: the scope's own evidence of identity, epoch and freshness lives in here, so a representation from an ended scope cannot resolve in a new one. |
| `contract` | `string` | required | — | The declaration the binding implements, family/Type. It is nominal: a reference is usable exactly where the callable it was declared as is expected. |

### Release

A record. Release of a binding: idempotent, and the same operation whether the releasing side exported it or imported it.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `binding` | `string` | required | — | The binding to release. |

### Released

A record. What a release answers; it carries nothing, since release is idempotent and says nothing about what the binding did.

## Carried types

These are this family's own types, declared in the same language by a built-in family Nightseam declares of itself and imported by the tier that brings it, with no `imports` line. A declaration of this family may not declare one and names it by the built-in that declares it — `duplex.Envelope`.

### Envelope

A record, carried from the built-in `duplex` family. One message of the nightseam.duplex/1 profile: the members the peer acts on, and nothing else.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `integer` | required | — | The profile's version, 1. |
| `kind` | `string` | required | — | request, response, event or cancel. |
| `id` | `string` | optional | — | What correlates a response or a cancel with its request. |
| `method` | `string` | optional | — | The method a request names. |
| `params` | `json` | optional | — | A request's parameters. |
| `result` | `json` | optional | — | A response's result. |
| `error` | `json` | optional | — | A response's error. |
| `event` | `string` | optional | — | The event an event frame names. |
| `data` | `json` | optional | — | An event's data. |
| `traceparent` | `string` | optional | — | The W3C Trace Context of the frame. |
| `tracestate` | `string` | optional | — | The vendor state of that trace. |
| `meta` | map of `string` | optional | — | What a request or an event carries about the call, delivered to the handler beside the payload. |

### Handle

A record, carried from the built-in `duplex` family. A reference to a channel on the connection that carries the message holding it.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | `integer` | required | — | The channel's id on that connection. |

## Server side

The server implements these methods and emits these events.

| Method | Request | Result | Errors | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `live.invoke` | `Invoke` | `Invoked` | `contract_invalid`, `contract_mismatch`, `reference_unknown`, `reference_foreign`, `reference_released`, `scope_closed`, `too_many_exports`, `too_many_imports` | Invokes an exported binding; either side may invoke what the other exported. |
| `live.release` | `Release` | `Released` | `scope_closed` | Releases a binding and its aliases; idempotent, and not a call on what the binding implements. |

### `live.invoke` on the wire

The client sends:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "id": "c:1",
  "method": "live.invoke",
  "params": {
    "binding": "‹binding›",
    "contract": "‹contract›",
    "request": {}
  }
}
```

The server answers:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "result": {
    "result": {}
  }
}
```

Or refuses with `contract_invalid`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "error": {
    "code": "contract_invalid",
    "message": "The reference carries no contract, or one this peer cannot read."
  }
}
```

Or refuses with `contract_mismatch`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "error": {
    "code": "contract_mismatch",
    "message": "The binding implements another declaration than the one expected here."
  }
}
```

Or refuses with `reference_unknown`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "error": {
    "code": "reference_unknown",
    "message": "No such binding in this scope."
  }
}
```

Or refuses with `reference_foreign`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "error": {
    "code": "reference_foreign",
    "message": "The reference was minted by another scope; a representation does not travel between scopes."
  }
}
```

Or refuses with `reference_released`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "error": {
    "code": "reference_released",
    "message": "The binding was released."
  }
}
```

Or refuses with `scope_closed`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "error": {
    "code": "scope_closed",
    "message": "The live scope has ended with its connection."
  }
}
```

Or refuses with `too_many_exports`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "error": {
    "code": "too_many_exports",
    "message": "The scope holds as many exported bindings as it will."
  }
}
```

Or refuses with `too_many_imports`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "error": {
    "code": "too_many_imports",
    "message": "The scope holds as many imported bindings as it will."
  }
}
```

## Errors

The public errors of the family, by code: what a call may fail with.

| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| `contract_invalid` | The reference carries no contract, or one this peer cannot read. |
| `contract_mismatch` | The binding implements another declaration than the one expected here. |
| `reference_foreign` | The reference was minted by another scope; a representation does not travel between scopes. |
| `reference_released` | The binding was released. |
| `reference_unknown` | No such binding in this scope. |
| `scope_closed` | The live scope has ended with its connection. |
| `too_many_exports` | The scope holds as many exported bindings as it will. |
| `too_many_imports` | The scope holds as many imported bindings as it will. |
